title: Stoichiometrically Controlled Assembly of Lanthanide Molecular Complexes of the Heteroditopic Divergent Ligand 4'-(4-Pyridyl)-2,2':6',2''-terpyridine N-Oxide in Hypodentate or Bridging Coordination Modes. Structural, Magnetic, and Photoluminescence Studies

synthesis.procedure: 200 mL of aqueous NaOH (0.1 M) was slowly added to an aqueous solution of YCl3 (0.304 M, 20 mL; 6.08 mmol) under vigorous stirring. The Y(OH)3 suspension was filtered, washed with small amounts of water, and dried under vacuum for 2 h. The solid was transferred to a Schlenk flask with toluene (75 mL), dme (5 mL), and Htta (4.04 g; 18.19 mmol). The suspension was heated at reflux for 2 h and filtered to remove unreacted Y(OH)3. An aqueous phase formed during the reaction was removed with a Pasteur pipette. The solution was evaporated under vacuum to a pale-yellow solid, which was washed with heptane (20 mL), filtered, and dried under vacuum for 8 h, giving Y(tta)3(dme).

synthesis.procedure: pyterpyNO (0.14 g, 0.43 mmol) was added to a vigorously stirred solution of Y(tta)3(dme) (0.35 g, 0.42 mmol) in toluene (15 mL). The suspension was heated at 70 °C until the ligand dissolved, then cooled to room temperature. Heptane (45 mL) precipitated a colorless solid, which was filtered and dried under vacuum for 4 h. Single crystals were grown by slow evaporation of a chloroform solution.

properties.summary: Room-temperature chiMT is below the free-ion value and falls further below about 5.5 K because of weak antiferromagnetic exchange through the N-oxide bridges (J negative). Zero-field ac data show two relaxation processes; the faster is nearly temperature-independent QTM, and the slower is assigned to an Orbach process. Under 1 kOe the effective barrier increases to 70(2) K (Orbach/direct), with slightly faster relaxation above about 7.5 K attributed to overcoming the exchange bias. SMM behavior is observed without an applied field.

properties.summary: Powder samples show ligand-sensitized bright red Eu3+ emission visible to the naked eye from the ultraviolet into the visible. Diffuse-reflectance absorption and excitation profiles resemble those of 11 but are bathochromically shifted by about 10 nm, attributed to low-energy charge-transfer character. Emission is only 5D0 to 7FJ (J = 0-4) 4f-4f lines; the weak 5D0-7F0 band indicates low site symmetry. Relative band intensities are insensitive to excitation wavelength and are dominated by the beta-diketonate ligands.

synthesis.procedure: In a Schlenk flask, Y(tta)3(dme) (0.52 g, 0.62 mmol) and pyterpyNO (0.10 g, 0.31 mmol) were dissolved in dce (20 mL) and stirred for 2 days. Addition of heptane (8 mL) gave a brown oil, so the mixture was evaporated to dryness. The colorless solid was recrystallized from toluene (4 mL) and heptane (4 mL), filtered, and dried under vacuum for 8 h. Cooling the filtrate to -20 °C gave more solid with the same IR spectrum.

synthesis.procedure: pyterpyNO (0.07 g, 0.21 mmol) and Dy(tta)3(dme) (0.39 g, 0.43 mmol) were dissolved in toluene (10 mL) with vigorous stirring and stirred for 2 days. Heptane (40 mL) precipitated a colorless solid, which was filtered and dried under vacuum for 8 h. Slow evaporation of a toluene solution gave single crystals. Crystals collapse on drying or standing in air; disordered toluene was treated by SQUEEZE.
synthesis.time: stirred 2 days; dried 8 h under vacuum
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: heptane precipitation, filtration, vacuum drying; crystals by slow evaporation of toluene

properties.summary: chiMT at room temperature is below the four-Dy(III) free-ion value and decreases to 1.8 K, with a faster drop below about 6 K from weak antiferromagnetic coupling in the central N-oxide-bridged Dy2 unit (J similar to 6). Peripheral terpyridine-bound Dy ions were modeled as uncoupled Ising spins. Zero-field relaxation is Raman plus QTM (n = 4.5(2)); a 1 kOe field increases the relaxation rate and is fit by Raman/direct or Raman/QTM (n = 3.25(6)). SMM-like slow relaxation occurs without an applied field.

properties.summary: Like 7, powders give antenna-sensitized red Eu3+ emission (5D0 to 7FJ, J = 0-4) visible by eye. Absorption and excitation profiles match 7 except for the about 10 nm shift. The spectrum contains both CN 8 and CN 9 sites; the largest differences versus 7 are in the 5D0-7F2 and 5D0-7F4 crystal-field patterns. No lifetime or quantum yield is given in the main text.

material_class.structural_family: pentanuclear complex proposed from a 5:3 metal:ligand stoichiometry; two tta environments in a 2:3 ratio; structure not determined by X-ray

synthesis.procedure: In an NMR tube, pyterpyNO (6.5 mg, 2.0e-5 mol) and La(tta)3(dme) (29.2 mg, 3.3e-5 mol) were suspended in anhydrous C6D6 (1 mL). Sonication and mild heating produced a solution. The bulk description is reaction of La(tta)3(dme) with pyterpyNO in toluene at room temperature in a 5:3 molar ratio. No single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained.
